title: Edit Distance in l1: Matching Bounds up to Constants in the Exponent

abstractEnglish: We determine the exponential scale of the least ℓ1 distortion of unit-cost edit distance on all strings of length at most d. For every sufficiently large d, uniformly over finite alphabets of size at least two, the distortion lies between $`\exp(c\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ and $`\exp(C\sqrt{\log d\,\log\log d})`$ for absolute constants $`c,C\gt 0`$. The lower bound already holds on binary strings of one common length. Thus the order of logarithmic distortion is sharp up to absolute constants.
titleEn: Edit Distance in l1: Matching Bounds up to Constants in the Exponent
titleZh: ℓ1中的编辑距离：指数中常数意义下的匹配界

details.overview: 稿件研究单位代价编辑距离在长度至多d的所有字符串上的最小ℓ1扭曲的指数尺度。作者声称，对充分大的d，一致于大小至少为二的有限字母表，扭曲介于exp(c√(log d log log d))与exp(C√(log d log log d))之间，其中c,C为绝对常数。下界已在等长二进制字符串上成立。因此对数扭曲的阶在绝对常数意义下是紧的，解决了该问题指数尺度的上下界匹配。
keyPoints: 确定编辑距离ℓ1扭曲的指数尺度为exp(Θ(√(log d log log d)))。
下界已在等长二进制字符串上成立，上界对任意有限字母表一致。
结果将扭曲阶确定到绝对常数因子。
